blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Much like last year’s NCAA Finals, Letran’s back is against the wall again, this time in the Season 102 men’s basketball Final Four. The Knights fumbled Game 1, falling to the Jose Rizal University Heavy Bombers in overtime, 102-98, on Monday night. Despite the heartbreaking loss, however, coach Allen Ricardo remained confident about Letran’s chances to return to the championship round. “We’re still optimistic. We were there. We knew that it should’ve been done [in regulation] supposedly,” Ricardo told reporters. “Baka pinapasarap lang.” Letran had multiple chances to win the game, but JRU just refused to lose.
